details.detail: Surface detail: value, panel tone, seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe, placards, grime
details.note: Fastener strips FIXED: w19A row 500 strip 174-176 on 169 -> 162-164 on 168 (0.97), row 520 163-164 on 168; w26K row 280 x 451-456 181-187 on 175 -> 175-177 (flush); single dot column, dots 159-162 (0.95). No ladders at range. Now slightly under KN41's ~0.80 dot rows, so the near rows are faint. Hinge smudges PARTLY fixed: dark head 127-128 on 163 (0.78), ~10 x 3 px, still a uniform hard-edged block; the tail is faint and reads (z_smudge right). Reads as a dark tab more than soot.
Unchanged (s_w26K left/right identical on the pods; c_canoe_side diff 0.08 %).

Crease along the crown gone (softer t^1.5 taper); dome -> saddle -> rise reads as _137's sequence and the flank meets the cowl more softly (cmp_pylon_w13A rows 1-2 vs 3). Residuals: a small secondary ripple on the crown between the saddle and the rise (w13A ~x 520-540), and the dome's front is a long gentle ramp where _137's dome is taller and steeper-fronted with a crisp shadow edge on the cowl.

details.detail: Nacelle geometry (cowl, lip, splits, strake, access panel)
details.note: New upper fan-cowl hinge hairline, correctly placed between the splits, but it is the darkest line on the nacelle: w13A cols 560-650 52-55 on 174-183 (0.30), 1 px, stair-stepped, while the cowl splits are 101-133 on 175 (0.6-0.75). _136/_137 show no hard dark line there (at most a faint seam), so it reads as a pen stroke. Cowl, lip, strake, access panel unchanged.

Cowl weathering mottle added: visible in c_nacelle_left as soft blotches; in-window it is subtle (w13A clean patch high-pass SD 0.32 -> 0.52, mean unchanged 152). Plausible vs _136's faint mottle and not tiled-looking. Monogram unchanged.

NOT fixed, slightly worse: w11K fan end row 420 61 -> 66, row 350 53 -> 58 (r16 was 50); knav _9 ~10. The smooth(0.45,1.25) window moved the darkening aft, past what 11K sees. w11A lip end 20-37 -> 24-37 (LALF _136 31-66), right direction. Spinner still unreadable from seats.
Night glow now a small lens inside the tip LE corner instead of a halo on top (n19A); day wicks unchanged.

Pale rivet ladders gone. Remaining: the aliased 1-px black hinge hairline on the fan cowl (dashed at 1x in w13A), the hard-edged smudge heads, the pylon crown ripple. No z-fighting, gaps or floating parts.
